name: Amfracti
source:
A visual novel in which you, in the role of a medical school sophomore, finally get your chance to shine by investigating a mysterious and terminal disease called Amfracti. Your job is to discuss the disease with affected patients and hopefully find out how to cure them.

[From [url=https://fofonos.itch.io/amfracti]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中，你扮演一名医学院二年级学生，通过调查一种名为Amfracti的神秘绝症，终于获得了大放异彩的机会。你的工作是与受影响的患者讨论这种疾病，并希望找出治愈方法。

[来自[url=https://fofonos.itch.io/amfracti]Itch.io[/url]]
